title: CodeRM-NT: Reward Model for Code RL without Unit Tests
authors_zh: Xiao Xia, Dan Zhang, Tianrui Sun
paper_type_zh: 代码奖励模型与强化学习方法论文
best_for_zh: 需要在缺少可靠单元测试时构建、审计或复现代码强化学习奖励的研究者。
one_line: A code reward-model pipeline that judges execution traces and releases the associated code/data artifact.
CodeRM-NT 以 MCTS 生成的执行轨迹和 LLM judge 训练代码奖励模型，不依赖单元测试即可为代码 RL 提供反馈。
why: It provides an auditable judgment-required feedback surface for post-training reasoning data and evaluation.
inclusion_reason: Track 07 addition: the central contribution creates, calibrates, or audits rubric-, expert-, or LLM-judgment data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Code-generation RL commonly treats unit-test pass/fail as reward, but trustworthy tests are expensive to author and validate. LLM-synthesized tests can instead accept wrong programs or reject correct ones, so scaling a new code corpus can scale noisy feedback rather than functional correctness.

CodeRM-NT replaces test-derived reward with a learned code reward model. It uses LLM-guided Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS), execution traces, and an LLM judge to create reward-labelled Python-code records, then uses the trained model for GRPO and difficulty-aware curriculum ordering.

代码生成的强化学习通常以单元测试是否通过作为奖励，但可靠测试的编写与核验代价很高。由 LLM 自动合成的测试还可能放过错误程序或错杀正确程序，使新代码语料的规模扩大时同时放大带噪反馈，而不是功能正确性。

CodeRM-NT 用学习得到的代码奖励模型替代测试奖励。它以 LLM 引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）、执行轨迹和 LLM judge 构造带奖励标签的 Python 代码记录，再将训练好的模型用于 GRPO 和按难度排序的课程学习。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: CodeRM-NT is a code reward model that learns functional-quality signals without unit tests: MCTS exposes partial and complete programs to an execution-trace LLM judge, and their back-propagated scores supervise scalar and pairwise reward learning. The contribution changes the feedback object from a generated test verdict to an execution-grounded model judgment. The authors release code, training pipelines, and a model, but do not identify a separately downloadable reward-data dataset; the paper reports 196,098 scalar response records and 71,205 pairs constructed from Magicoder-OSS-Instruct-75K.

CodeRM-NT 是一个不依赖单元测试的代码奖励模型：MCTS 将完整和部分程序及其执行轨迹交给 LLM judge，回传分数同时监督标量与成对奖励学习。它把反馈对象从“合成测试的通过判定”改为“基于执行证据的模型判断”。作者开放代码、训练流程和模型，但未标出可单独下载的奖励数据集；论文报告从 Magicoder-OSS-Instruct-75K 构造了196,098条标量响应记录和71,205个响应对。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build search states. For each Python question, Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct generates code. The system splits it at indentation boundaries and LLM-inserted print statements; prefixes become MCTS nodes.
  1. Expand and judge execution. MCTS selects nodes with UCT, asks the LLM to complete a prefix, inserts diagnostic prints and sample calls, then executes the code. An LLM judge sees the question, code, and trace, assigns a normalized 0–1 score, and that reward is back-propagated. No unit test decides acceptance.
  1. Create reward supervision. Non-root nodes yield question, partial-or-complete response, and Q-value records. From 12,000 sampled Magicoder questions, 6,000 produce 196,098 scalar records and 6,000 produce 71,205 ordered pairs.
  1. Train and apply the reward model. A Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct backbone first fits scalar rewards with MSE, then pairs with contrastive loss. During GRPO it scores complete policy outputs; it can also average eight sampled scores per question to order easier examples before harder ones.

Reproduction requires the MCTS prompts, execution sandbox, Qwen2.5-Coder-32B judge/generator, data revisions, and RL configuration. Sampling seeds, full compute budget, and the released reward-data file format are not fully disclosed.

1. 建立搜索状态。 对每道 Python 题，Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct 生成代码；系统按缩进边界和 LLM 插入的 print 语句切分，代码前缀成为 MCTS 节点。
  1. 扩展并判断执行。 MCTS 以 UCT 选择节点，令 LLM 补全前缀、插入诊断打印和示例调用后执行。LLM judge 阅读题目、代码和轨迹，给出0–1分并回传；没有单元测试决定样本去留。
  1. 构造奖励监督。 收集非根节点的题目、部分或完整响应及 Q 值。12,000道 Magicoder 题中各6,000道形成196,098条标量记录和71,205个有序响应对。
  1. 训练和应用模型。 以 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct 为骨干，先用 MSE 拟合标量奖励，再以对比损失训练响应对。GRPO 时只为完整策略输出打分；也可对每题采样8个响应取均分，按由易到难排序。

复现须固定 MCTS prompts、执行沙箱、Qwen2.5-Coder-32B 生成器兼 judge、数据版本和 RL 配置；随机种子、完整计算预算和奖励数据文件格式未完全披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim. Execution-trace reward modeling is a usable alternative to synthetic unit-test reward for code RL. Controlled setup. Table 1 trains Qwen3-4B-Thinking on 5,000 OpenCodeInstruct questions and compares reward sources under the reported GRPO recipe; the salient change is CodeRM-NT versus synthetic tests.

Result. CodeRM-NT reaches a 72.7 average pass@1 across HumanEval(+), MBPP(+), LiveCodeBench-v5, and BigCodeBench-Instruct Hard, versus 72.1 for synthetic tests; its LiveCodeBench-v5 and BigCodeBench scores are 52.1 and 22.3 versus 50.3 and 25.7. Table 3 also reports 0.963 RewardBench hep-python accuracy, versus 0.957 for AceCodeRM-7B.

Boundary. This supports the disclosed Python, model, data, and reward recipes, not semantic correctness of all LLM-judged traces or superiority on multi-file software work.

主张。 基于执行轨迹的奖励建模可替代代码 RL 的合成单元测试奖励。受控设置。 表1在5,000道 OpenCodeInstruct 题上训练 Qwen3-4B-Thinking，并按论文所述 GRPO 配方比较奖励来源；会改变归因的差异是 CodeRM-NT 与合成测试。

结果。 CodeRM-NT 在 HumanEval(+) 、MBPP(+) 、LiveCodeBench-v5 和 BigCodeBench-Instruct Hard 上的平均 pass@1 为72.7，合成测试为72.1；前者在 LiveCodeBench-v5 和 BigCodeBench 上为52.1和22.3，后者为50.3和25.7。表3的 RewardBench hep-python 准确率为0.963，AceCodeRM-7B 为0.957。

边界。 这只支持披露的 Python、模型、数据和奖励配置，不能证明所有由 LLM judge 判断的轨迹都具备语义正确性，也不证明其适用于多文件软件工程。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier code-RL systems use ground-truth tests or synthesize tests and then attempt to verify them; both make the test oracle the reward bottleneck. CodeRM-NT instead searches over code prefixes and has an LLM judge the instrumented execution trace, turning node values into scalar and pairwise reward data. Its distinct change is therefore the construction of supervision from partial execution evidence, rather than merely adding another code reward model or using MCTS. The benefit depends on the judge's ability to interpret traces.
既有代码 RL 要么使用真实单元测试，要么先合成测试再试图核验，测试 oracle 始终是奖励瓶颈。CodeRM-NT 转而搜索代码前缀，并让 LLM 判断插桩后的执行轨迹，将节点价值写成标量和成对奖励数据。因此新意在于从部分执行证据构造监督，而不只是增加一个代码奖励模型或使用 MCTS。其收益仍取决于 judge 对轨迹的解释能力。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The authors evaluate only Python function-level generation. Their splitting rule relies on indentation and LLM-chosen print locations, so transfer to other languages requires a new syntax-aware design; verify it rather than treating the stated possibility as evidence.

Multi-file repositories, external APIs, and stateful software enlarge both the search and trace-capture problem. The method's LLM judge also remains an imperfect verifier: before reuse, audit judge errors against independently checked programs and sandbox all execution.

作者只评估 Python 的函数级生成。切分规则依赖缩进和 LLM 选定的 print 位置，迁移到其他语言需要另行设计面向语法的规则；不能把论文所说的“可扩展”当作实证结论，应先验证。

多文件仓库、外部 API 与有状态系统会扩大搜索和轨迹采集难题。LLM judge 仍是不完美验证器；复用前应以独立核验的程序审计 judge 错误，并在隔离沙箱中执行代码。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For a team with Python coding prompts but no reliable tests, adapt the MCTS-to-trace-judge pipeline to produce scored partial and complete programs, train a reward model, and compare GRPO against a fixed test-based or human-checked baseline. Retain the question, code, execution trace, prompt, judge version, and score so reward errors can be audited.

Use the model's average score to order a fixed training set only after checking that score tracks difficulty on held-out, independently verified problems. Do not reuse its acceptance rule for unsafe code, languages without a validated trace design, or repository tasks without isolation and a new judge audit.

若团队有 Python 编程 prompts 却缺少可靠测试，可改造“ MCTS→轨迹 judge ”流程，产出带分数的部分和完整程序，训练奖励模型，并在固定的人审或测试奖励基线上比较 GRPO。应保留题目、代码、执行轨迹、prompt、judge 版本和分数，才能审计奖励错误。

只有在独立核验的问题上证明平均分与难度相关后，才可用它排序固定训练集。对于不安全代码、没有验证过轨迹设计的语言，或未隔离且未审计 judge 的仓库任务，不应直接沿用其接受规则。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Positioning. CodeRM-NT replaces synthetic unit-test rewards with an LLM judgment of executed Python-code traces.
  2. Mechanism. UCT search expands code prefixes; inserted prints and sample calls expose state, and the judge's 0–1 score is back-propagated into node rewards.
  3. Artifact. The repository releases MCTS, reward-training, and RL code plus a model; the paper reports 196,098 scalar responses and 71,205 pairs, not a separately named downloadable reward dataset.
  4. Evidence anchor. With Qwen3-4B-Thinking and 5,000 OpenCodeInstruct questions, Table 1 reports 72.7 average pass@1 versus 72.1 for synthetic tests; Table 3 reports 0.963 hep-python reward accuracy.
  5. Reuse decision. It suits audited Python reward learning without tests; first measure LLM-judge error on independently checked programs and keep execution sandboxed.

1. 定位。 CodeRM-NT 用 LLM 对已执行 Python 代码轨迹的判断，替代合成单元测试奖励。
  2. 方法抓手。 UCT 搜索扩展代码前缀；插入 print 与示例调用暴露状态，judge 的0–1分回传为节点奖励。
  3. 数据与产物。 仓库开放 MCTS、奖励训练、RL 代码和模型；论文报告196,098条标量响应与71,205个响应对，未列出独立命名、可下载的奖励数据集。
  4. 证据锚点。 Qwen3-4B-Thinking 在5,000道 OpenCodeInstruct 题上平均 pass@1 为72.7，合成测试为72.1；hep-python 奖励准确率为0.963。
  5. 复用决定。 适合无测试的受审计 Python 奖励学习；先测 judge 在独立核验程序上的错误率，并使用执行沙箱。
